description: Restore an archived (soft-deleted) price book so it can price quotes and runs again. The book and its grid reappear in lists and the resolve path accepts them. Two-step: preview=true shows the book and what references it and returns a single-use previewReceipt; repeat the call with that receipt and a fresh idempotencyKey to restore. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

bookId.description: The archived price book id (GUID) to restore.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to see the book being restored and receive a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit the restore.

name: restore_price_book
title: Restore Price Book
